items.title: Not Toying Around: Hasbro Attack May Take 'Weeks' to Remediate
items.description: The company's 8-K filing notes "unauthorized access" and that it has activated business continuity plans and taken some systems offline.

items.title: Hackers Exploit CVE-2025-55182 to Breach 766 Next.js Hosts, Steal Credentials
items.description: A large-scale credential harvesting operation has been observed exploiting the React2Shell vulnerability as an initial infection vector to steal database credentials, SSH private keys, Amazon Web Services (AWS) secrets, shell command history, Stripe API keys, and GitHub tokens at scale. items.title: Security Bosses Are All-In on AI. Here's Why
items.description: CISOs are bullish on AI and have big plans to roll out future tools. We talk to Reddit CISO Frederick Lee and leading analyst Dave Gruber about how AI is working out in the real world, as well as its future promise.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-29886: Adobe
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Brandon Evans' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-04-02, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-07-31 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
